=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12156-12159 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `grep -E '^::error::  -'` pattern leaves `_gate_violations` empty, so blocked waves never surface parsed violation lines in the tracking comment.
  WHY: The gate still blocks correctly, but operators only see the fallback "no violation lines parsed" message and must inspect raw logs to diagnose the failure.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:642 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The unknown-option check only rejects leading `--` args, so a mistyped flag after the positional fingerprints path is treated as the path instead of an error.
  WHY: A trailing unknown flag can produce a misleading file-open/plumbing error and misroute direct verifier invocations.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:698-705 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The unknown-flag validation does not catch flags placed after the positional fingerprints path, so they are silently ignored.
  WHY: `verify.py fingerprints.json --unknown` runs against `fingerprints.json` and drops the extra flag, which can hide operator mistakes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12138-12152 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The EXIT trap is registered before `_gate_fp_file`/`_gate_log_file` are populated, so an early exit before `mktemp` leaves cleanup with no paths to remove.
  WHY: Early termination in that window can leave `/tmp/wave_dispatch_*` artifacts behind instead of cleaning them up.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:115-145 (_read_file / _path_exists ref-mode) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Git plumbing/permission/unknown-ref failures are collapsed to `content=None`/`exists=False`, which makes ref-mode look like an absent file.
  WHY: The gate can silently dispatch on regressed integration state because the verifier treats infrastructure errors as satisfying absence checks.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:103,156,401,502 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Adding `ref: str | None = None` changes the helper call signature, so old positional callers can be shifted into ref-mode.
  WHY: External or stale callers may start producing spurious must_not_exist violations or mixed-signal results after the API shape change.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:642 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Flag after positional fp_path is consumed as fp_path; malformed invocation gives misleading file-open error instead of explicit unknown-option diagnostic.
  WHY: Direct verifier call with a mistyped arg after the intended file name silently misroutes and can make the wave-gate misinterpret the path as valid fingerprint JSON.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12159 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Verifier violation lines start with `::error::  -` (no trailing space before the dash in current output) so grep never matches.
  WHY: The blocked-wave comment hides the exact regression path and forces operators to hunt workflow logs, delaying stall recovery and escalation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12145 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Trap body uses `${_gate_fp_file:-}` before first mktemp; early exit before allocation leaves cleanup no-op.
  WHY: Repeated gate blocks in a long-running poller can accumulate `/tmp/wave_dispatch_*` files because cleanup only happens on the clean path.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:115-145 (_read_file / _path_exists ref-mode) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Plumbing/permission/unknown-ref failures are swallowed and treated as `absent` for `must_not_exist` / `must_contain`.
  WHY: The wave-gate can silently dispatch on regressed integration state because there is no clear error for the operator.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:103,156,401,502 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Public helper signatures changed; positional callers expecting the old shape silently shift into ref-mode.
  WHY: External or old bootstrap copies or tests may start producing spurious `must_not_exist` violations or mixed-signal results.
